notes: Linked kits can be built in Site settings as a Rust inventory, with item images and durability from Looty.
added: Place kit items in clothing, the main inventory, and the hotbar. Drag them between slots.
Click an empty slot to search for an item. Click an item to set the amount, and durability when the item has it.
changed: The Link page shows that inventory, with the server picker beside the kit title.
Kit dropdowns match the other admin selectors, and opening one no longer hides the page scrollbar.
Steam profile pictures load from the picture host Steam uses.
A custom favicon URL can be saved in the Site Editor.
